cover.title: 5 niche ways to find the users who almost paid you

inner.title: build a closed funnel
inner.body: in ga4 explore, make a closed funnel: view_item, begin_checkout, add_payment_info, purchase. ga4 allows up to 10 steps, so watching only purchase means you only ever see the winners.

inner.title: read the silence
inner.body: turn on the next-action card for the step after begin_checkout. google says a "(no next action)" entry means many users completed a step and did nothing, and that silence is your almost-paid list.

inner.title: split by device
inner.body: break the funnel down by device category and add up to 4 segments. one broken step on mobile hides inside a healthy total, and you never see the phone where buyers quit.

inner.title: time the hesitation
inner.body: switch on show elapsed time to get the average gap between steps. a long wait before payment is doubt, and a conversion rate alone will never show it.

inner.title: audit the last-step price
inner.body: baymard says 39% of shoppers abandon a checkout over extra fees like delivery and taxes, and 19% when forced to create an account. if your price changes at the last step, you made them leave.

closer.HEADLINE:
they wanted to pay.
you never looked.
